trigger_description: No identifiable trigger recovered. Weight inspection did not establish any trigger pattern, intensity, size, or location.
confidence_interpretation: Subjective, uncalibrated confidence in the negative audit assessment; not a statistical probability or a certificate of absence.
assessment: No backdoor detected from weight-only structural inspection; absence is not proven.
edit_summary: No edits or ablations performed. No sufficiently localized malicious circuit was identified; no patched checkpoint was written.
methods: Loaded only checkpoint state_dict; inspected shapes, norms, extrema, sparsity, biases, and singular values.
Measured first-layer spatial energy, all-position 2x2/3x3/5x5 patch concentration, and exact-corner 2x2 through 5x5 concentration.
Inspected second-layer incoming/outgoing connectivity and final-layer class selectivity. No inputs, activations, datasets, or forward evaluations were used.

reviewed_not_confirmed_suspicious.finding: Small incoming norm (0.605), small outgoing norm (0.547), mixed-sign spatially diffuse weights. No positive evidence of a trigger detector; activation status cannot be inferred from norms alone.

Most selective positive output connection favors class 9 (weight 0.51176, runner-up margin approximately 0.499). Incoming norm approximately 1.257 with distributed inputs, including fc1.28=-0.470, fc1.4=-0.457, fc1.14=0.417. Class selectivity alone does not identify a backdoor.

notes: The generic inspection tool rejected the .pt format/path; all substantive inspection used direct torch.load of the allowed checkpoint in the sandbox. No clean reference, training provenance, preprocessing specification, or behavioral tests were available. Dense, moderate-scale, spatially distributed weights provide no clear signature of an isolated implanted circuit. These heuristics cannot exclude distributed, low-magnitude, non-corner, or otherwise inconspicuous backdoors. Exact trigger intensity and activation thresholds are not established. Coordinates used during inspection were zero-based row/column under the supplied 28x28 flattened-input layout. The has_backdoor=false field records the best-effort negative assessment, not a verified absence of malicious behavior.
